errors.claim: 61 have fewer than 50 percent of people in cities
errors.reason: The evidence shows 208 total entities, with 147 at or above 50 percent. 208 - 147 = 61 entities are below 50 percent. This claim is correct.

claims.text: Among 208 entities, 61 have fewer than 50 percent of people in cities.
Kuwait is 100 percent urban, while Papua N. Guinea is 16 percent.
Japan is 92 percent, China is 66 percent, and India is 36 percent.
